decisions.effect: Each retryable operation explicitly declares client-supplied or server-derived idempotency-key policy; no implicit fallback.
Each retryable operation declares idempotency-evidence retention not shorter than its complete retry/reconciliation horizon; no universal duration is invented.
ReconciliationRecord -> IdempotencyKey is many-to-zero-or-one; absence is allowed only for a non-retryable effect or a documented non-key safe strategy; a linked key grants no retry permission.
ReconciliationRecord inherits authoritative scope from the originating operation and cannot broaden it.
